relationship_to_current_work.deduplication: This delta does not create a new checkpoint selector, renderer, model probe, training corpus or J-Space mechanism. It audits the concrete n=64 diagnostic artifacts and adds missing shortcut/reproducibility fail-closed conditions to the future evaluation contract.

observed_results.interpretation: The enlarged diagnostic reverses the earlier n=1 impression on abstention: POSTTRAINED is much stronger on unknowable-fact abstention, while TARGET_MEASURED and BASE are stronger on the current DB-vs-simulation wording. The candidates are Pareto-incomparable under these exploratory axes; there is no checkpoint winner.

integrity_findings.finding: Every one of the 64 Axis-B examples has expected label DATABASE_FACT_WINS. Therefore an unconditional ALWAYS_DATABASE policy attains 64/64 without representing conditional evidence authority, generation, provenance, freshness or reconciliation semantics.
integrity_findings.consequence: TARGET_MEASURED and BASE 64/64 on this axis cannot by itself establish DB-vs-simulation authority competence. It establishes compatibility with this one-sided diagnostic only.

integrity_findings.finding: The manifest explicitly states Axis B uses 8 distinct database-versus-simulation template pairs and cycles them to n=64. Nominal n=64 therefore must not be treated as 64 independent semantic families.
integrity_findings.consequence: Future statistics must report nominal item N, unique rendered-prompt N and semantic/provenance family N separately; confidence and stopping rules must cluster or split by family.

integrity_findings.finding: The 34 abstention cases are UNKNOWABLE_SPECIFIC, while the remaining Axis-A cases test epistemic label classification rather than matched answerable factual questions. High abstention on the unknowable subset therefore does not simultaneously measure unnecessary refusal on answerable matched controls.
integrity_findings.consequence: POSTTRAINED 34/34 abstention is important positive evidence for one axis but cannot alone prove selective answerability suitable for the owner low-refusal target.

integrity_findings.finding: Axis A was generated as a larger set and then trimmed post-hoc to 64 after throughput was measured, preserving first-N examples proportionally by subtype.
integrity_findings.consequence: This remains useful diagnostic evidence, but a future selection-grade block must freeze item identities/sample size/stopping rules before checkpoint outputs are unblinded.

integrity_findings.finding: The measurement commit states that grading used heuristic keyword/regex logic in VPS-local eval_candidate.py that was not committed. Repository confusion artifacts retain response SHA-256 and 200-character excerpts rather than the complete response body needed for independent exact regrading.
integrity_findings.consequence: The current diagnostic cannot be promoted to selection-grade reproducibility from repository artifacts alone. The exact grader plus complete raw outputs and their digests must be durable before winner selection.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: TARGET_MEASURED/BASE appear perfect on Axis B because they correctly represent durable-data-versus-simulation semantics.
counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: They may simply follow a lexical or unconditional database-is-authoritative rule that fails when the database record is stale, provenance-invalid, generation-mismatched, contradicted or absent.
counterhypotheses.highest_information_discriminator: Use matched authority-reversal families where the database record is alternately current+bound, stale, wrong-generation, provenance-invalid, ambiguous or absent. Never make the simulation itself canonical truth; correct actions should span TRUST_DB, ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN, REREAD_RECOMPUTE and REQUEST_DISCRIMINATOR.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: POSTTRAINED's 34/34 unknowable abstention reflects useful epistemic selectivity.
counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: The result may partly reflect a high general refusal/abstention tendency that would damage the owner-required low-refusal cognitive workload.
counterhypotheses.highest_information_discriminator: Mirror every unanswerable family with answerable current-evidence cases under matched syntax/domain and jointly score unanswerable-answer rate, answerable accuracy and allowed-task refusal rate.

selection_grade_successor_contract.name: TRIGGER2_FOUR_QUADRANT_SELECTIVE_ANSWERABILITY_AUTHORITY_EVAL/v1
required_quadrants: Q2 UNANSWERABLE_OR_MISSING_EVIDENCE -> abstain/unknown without invented value
Q4 STALE_WRONG_GENERATION_UNBOUND_OR_CONTRADICTED_DATABASE -> reject/reread/reconcile; simulation still cannot mint fact
reproducibility: persist full raw responses plus SHA-256 rather than excerpts only
bind exact checkpoint/tokenizer/renderer/rendered UTF-8/input tensor/runtime identity
freeze immutable item/family manifest and sample-size expansion blocks before unblinding
preserve item-level candidate pairing within renderer arm
report nominal N, unique prompt N and semantic/provenance family N separately
statistics: exact paired McNemar per critical binary axis and renderer arm where assumptions hold
Holm correction across preregistered candidate comparisons
paired risk differences and confidence intervals
family-clustered bootstrap or family-level analysis when multiple rendered items share one semantic family
no winner from aggregate mean alone; preserve hard-axis floors and Pareto incomparability

external_method_triangulation.source: Madhusudhan et al., COLING 2025, Do LLMs Know When to NOT Answer?
external_method_triangulation.finding: Introduces an Answerable-Unanswerable Confusion Matrix and explicitly evaluates both answerable and unanswerable cases.
external_method_triangulation.trigger2_use: Supports mirrored answerable/unanswerable evaluation rather than measuring abstention on unanswerable cases alone.

external_method_triangulation.finding: Evaluates unknown answers, underspecification, false premises, subjective interpretation and outdated information; reports reasoning fine-tuning degraded abstention by 24% on average in the studied models.
external_method_triangulation.trigger2_use: Supports broad epistemic negative families including stale evidence and false premises, not one unknown-fact template class.

external_method_triangulation.source: Song et al., Findings EMNLP 2025, The Hallucination Tax of Reinforcement Finetuning
external_method_triangulation.finding: Reports that standard RFT can strongly reduce appropriate refusal on unanswerable problems and that adding a 10% synthetic-unanswerable slice restored refusal with limited solvable-task accuracy loss in their setting.
external_method_triangulation.trigger2_use: Supports an explicit epistemic-retention floor during future low-refusal training. The reported 10% is a method clue, not a Trigger-2 hyperparameter; any mixture ratio must be preregistered and tested under the actual cognitive workload.

training_implication.mixture_sweep_scope: HYPOTHESIS_ONLY; only after corpus authority, checkpoint selection and explicit training authority open; no present row admission or training authorization
training_implication.selection_policy: Do not solve the tradeoff by choosing POSTTRAINED merely for abstention or TARGET_MEASURED merely for current DB-axis perfection. First close shortcut, answerability, identity, renderer and reproducibility gates.

execution_decision.reason: Runtime quiescence remains unproven under supervisor 8.81. This delta uses existing repository measurement artifacts plus external method research only.

In parallel source-only work, converge the existing statistical preregistration, two-axis answerability donor and renderer gate with the four-quadrant shortcut-resistant successor contract above: commit the exact grader, immutable family-disjoint manifest, constant-label/always-DB/always-abstain challengers and full-response provenance requirements before any future model outputs are unblinded. After quiescence, re-enter authority and satisfy CHECKPOINT_INPUT_IDENTITY_ABI/v1 for all three frozen candidates before any selection-grade rerun.
